name: Fairmont Wuhan
positioning: Fairmont luxury hotel in Wuhan's central business district, with an indoor pool and a Fairmont Gold lounge level
best_for: Travelers who want a city base in Wuhan's central business district
Guests who want a Fairmont Gold lounge with private check-in
Longer stays in a suite with a kitchen

facts.text: Fairmont Wuhan is located in the city's central business district.
The hotel's address is 249 Huaihai Road, Jianghan District, Wuhan.
The hotel has an indoor pool with views of the central business district.
The wellness area includes a poolside lounge, a wet steam room, a sauna, and yoga and fitness areas.
Rooms have a Nespresso coffee machine.
Rooms have a separate rain shower and bath.
The hotel has three restaurants and one lounge.

highlights.text: The hotel has an indoor pool with views of the central business district.
Fairmont Gold guests get private check-in and check-out and a dedicated concierge.
The Long Stay Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a kitchen.
Deluxe rooms have a Neo-classic interior.
Fairmont Gold rooms include access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge with breakfast and evening cocktails.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy commercial area with an urban setting.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
